summary: Deferred finalization causing intermittent 504s on sessions with very deep prompt + large max_tokens
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports requests receiving 504 / upstream timeout after ~60s when sending prompts with a very deep history (~120k tokens) and large max_tokens (>=50k). The generation proceeds for a while but final chunk never returns to the client; gateway logs show upstream timeout and the serving runtime shows a long 'finalizer' step for that session.

Impact: Multiple API calls from Codexify Labs' production dedicated pool are failing end-to-end for long chat sessions. User-visible: generation aborted mid-response; negative impact on user workflows. Estimated 15-20% of their long-context requests in the last 24h hit this.

Environment: Dedicated pool (codexify-dedicated-1) in us-east. Production traffic only. Model: redwood-v1-large pinned. Customer is on dedicated plan with autoscaling disabled for this pool.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Use customer's test harness to replay a saved chat session with ~100-140k token prefix.
2) Call Redwood text generation endpoint with max_tokens set to 50,000 and stream: true.
3) Observe generation proceeds for ~30-55s with streaming chunks, then final chunk stalls.
4) Client receives HTTP 504 (upstream timed out) from API gateway.

Note: Repro rate ~60% in customer's harness, lower when max_tokens lowered to <=10k.
logs:
gateway/nginx [2026-03-10T14:12:07Z] upstream timeout while reading response header from upstream, client: 198.51.100.23, server: api.redwood.company, request: "POST /v1/generate", upstream: "http://10.42.52.11:8080/", host: "api.redwood.company"
serving-runtime [pod/runtime-3] 2026-03-10T14:11:48Z INFO session=cid-0a12 Finalizer: entering flush_and_finalize (prefix_len=119842, generated=4213, kv_size=24GB)
serving-runtime [pod/runtime-3] 2026-03-10T14:12:12Z WARN session=cid-0a12 Finalizer: blocking on kv-compact (wall=24s)
serving-runtime [pod/runtime-3] 2026-03-10T14:12:47Z ERROR session=cid-0a12 Finalizer: timed out waiting for flush; aborting response
api-gateway [2026-03-10T14:12:47Z] 504 Upstream read timeout (after 60s) for request cid-0a12
investigation_notes:
Observations:
- Finalizer step (flush_and_finalize) duration spikes only for sessions with both a very large prefix (>=100k tokens) AND large max_tokens.
- Metrics show CPU and scheduler queueing on the runtime pod handling that session spiking during finalization window.
- KV cache compaction and re-serialization appear to run synchronously as part of the finalizer; compaction can take tens of seconds when kv_size is large.
- Upstream gateway has a 60s read timeout by default; when finalizer exceeds this, gateway returns 504 to client even though runtime may still be working.

Hypotheses:
1) Finalization performs blocking work (kv compaction + synchronous re-encode for deterministic streaming) on the request path; for very deep sessions this work can exceed gateway timeout.
2) Batch coalescing / continuous batching can delay flush triggers, increasing finalization latency under certain scheduling conditions.
3) Autoscaling disabled for the dedicated pool means heavy sessions land on a single pod and exacerbate queuing.

Initial mitigation attempted:
- Temporarily increased API gateway upstream_read_timeout to 180s for the customer's dedicated pool (applied 2026-03-11T03:40Z).
- Added a short-term patch to runtime that does non-blocking streaming flush earlier (PR linked), reducing observed finalizer tail in a canary.

Next steps:
- Add off-main-thread compaction path for KV operations (engineering task).
- Harden finalizer to chunk final flushes and avoid large re-encodes on main path.
- Re-evaluate default gateway timeouts or add per-customer overrides for dedicated pools.
